name: 06510 · New Haven, CT
findings: ZIP 06510 (New Haven) has 170 nonprofit organizations. 86 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 78 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06510 (New Haven) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06510 (New Haven) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 22.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 78 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
